bop.sign: BPM6 (IMF): fdi_in/portfolio_in/loans_net/other_inv_liabilities = net incurrence of liabilities (+ = inflow); fdi_out/portfolio_out/currency_deposits_assets/other_inv_assets = net acquisition of financial assets by residents (+ = outflow); *_net = liabilities - assets (+ = net inflow); reserves_change = net acquisition of reserve assets (+ = reserves rose); errors_omissions as published.

budget.qc_note: QC 2026-10-06: (1) 2025 expenditure.total 3,312,600 conflicts with ECON_OFFICIAL.budget_exp_bn[2025] = 2,401,500 (MoF Jan-2026); the 482,100 gap shows up as the "Khác" slice of the 2025 spending waffle. (2) deficit ≠ revenue − expenditure in every year (MoF deficit definition excludes/includes items differently from the cash totals); this is expected, not an error. (3) deficit_pct_gdp 2018–2020 (2.80, 2.67, 3.44) match the pre-2019-revision GDP denominator; on the current gdp.GDP series they would be 2.18, 2.10, 2.69. Published ratios kept. (4) MoF has not published the FY2025 final account (quyết toán) as of 2026-10-06, so 2025 stays "estimate".
